secrets.name: DATABASE_URL
secrets.description: Hosted Neon Postgres connection string for the Pact Neon runtime (Neon console -> Project -> Connection string, or `neon connection-string --project-id <id> --branch main`). Include sslmode=require; the role must own the tables so the baseline's RLS deny policies do not block the app. Optional for local work: without it the api service falls back to the compose Postgres via .env.base44-defaults.

secrets.name: SESSION_HMAC_SECRET
secrets.description: HMAC signing secret for wallet sessions (server-side only). Generated development placeholder; the app needs a real value for any shared environment.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key for the AI-gateway intent path (platform.openai.com). Without it POST /v1/agent/intents returns PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE while GET /health still answers 200.
